limitations: One sequential run per revision; no confidence interval or physical-device inference.
Save samples remain in original order. p50=sorted[15], p95=sorted[28], max=sorted[29]; two save groups are separate.
Counter deltas describe enclosing save windows, not simultaneous CPU execution or isolated SQL lock wait.
Different save durations produce different overlap windows; no claim that all 30 saves overlap read and index work.
Fixed request.notes contains preloaded bodies on baseline; candidate uses headers and refreshes database snapshots on notes invalidations.
searchIndexReadyMs is joint completion after saves/allRowsCommitted/ready await, not first-ready time or isolated index time.
Sparse progress logging is outside timed saves but may contribute to index wall time and scheduling.
Warm median is emitted from five direct reads; individual five timings were not emitted and cannot be independently recomputed.
Returned UTF-16 character counts are not disk bytes or all metadata rows scanned. Missing baseline projection observer remains null.
Matching environment snapshots exclude dynamic load/cache state and do not prove settings throughout each run; DBs use fresh UUIDs/timestamps.
Source/build/artifact/install records are cross-checked. No APK re-extraction or binary-reproducible source proof was performed in this review.
Full performance probe pass does not pass the separately failing original 10-second gate or unexecuted later assertions.
V3 is an intermediate sequence only; it is not pooled into the final baseline comparison.

environmentContinuityAudit.limitations: Matching snapshots do not attest dynamic load/cache state or settings at every instant between snapshots.
